faq.seoDescription: Find answers to common questions about BioMath Core: services, pricing, data security, reports, and more. Get quick answers to your health analytics questions.

categoriesOrg.question: How are categories organized?
categoriesOrg.answer: BioMath Core ships {{categoryCount}} health categories and {{serviceCount}} services (including Human Data Model tools). Each category groups services by real-life need — critical health, sleep, nutrition, longevity, senior care, and more.

catalogRef.title: Browse every service description
catalogRef.subtitle: Full live catalog — open a category to read each service name and description.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.body: Our team can help with account, billing, and service questions.

items.question: What makes BioMath Core different from other wellness apps?
items.answer: Rather than tracking numbers, we convert your body's signals into meaning, then into clear, gentle, personalized guidance. We focus on understanding, not overwhelm. Reassurance, not urgency. Interpretation, not diagnosis.

items.question: Is this a medical diagnosis tool?
items.answer: No. BioMath Core is wellness intelligence focused on interpretation, education, and preventive wellness. We help you understand how your body is responding day-to-day, but we never diagnose medical conditions. When something needs professional attention, we guide you clearly.

items.question: What can I expect from the guidance?
items.answer: Our guidance is supportive, not directive. Simple, not technical. We use no fear-based language. You never "fail" — you are learning. Every insight is designed to increase your confidence and reduce stress, not create anxiety.

items.question: What is BioMath Core?
items.answer: BioMath Core is wellness intelligence that helps you understand how your body is responding day-to-day and guides you with clear, gentle, personalized actions. It improves clarity, emotional safety, and proactive self-care without clinical pressure.

items.question: Who is BioMath Core for?
items.answer: For people who want clarity, calm explanations, and step-by-step improvement — not medical jargon or dashboards full of numbers. BioMath Core works for beginners, busy professionals, wellness users, and anyone improving long-term health.

items.question: Do I need medical knowledge to use it?
items.answer: No. Everything is explained in simple language. Reports, goals, and guidance are written as if you are talking to a human coach — not a clinician.

items.question: Is this a medical service?
items.answer: No. BioMath Core is a wellness service, not a medical provider. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions.

items.question: Do I need devices to start?
items.answer: No. You can begin with questionnaires only. Devices make reports more accurate, but they are optional.

items.question: How can I purchase a subscription?
items.answer: You can subscribe directly on the Pricing page. After checkout you will unlock advanced features inside the Member Zone.

items.question: What is included in each plan?
items.answer:
Basic: standard reports, core assistant, devices, and dashboards.
Pro: second opinion, deeper insights, PDF export, and smart nudges.
Enterprise: team-level features, analytics, and dedicated onboarding.

items.question: Can I start for free?
items.answer: Yes. Free onboarding is available before upgrading.

items.question: How do I upgrade or downgrade?
items.answer: You can change plans any time from your Account settings.

items.question: How can I cancel a subscription?
items.answer: You can cancel in 1 click inside your billing settings. Your access remains active until the end of the billing cycle.

items.question: Why do I need to answer questionnaires?
items.answer: They allow the system to understand your baseline and provide personalized context instead of generic tips.

items.question: How long does onboarding take?
items.answer: Usually 3–5 minutes.

items.question: Can I skip some questions?
items.answer: Yes. You can skip and complete them later.

items.question: Can I update answers later?
items.answer: Yes, at any time from the Member Zone.

items.question: How often should I refresh my answers?
items.answer: Whenever your health routines, sleep pattern, workload, or lifestyle change.

items.question: Do I need to use all categories?
items.answer: No. You only use what is relevant — nothing is forced.

items.question: Can I add more services later?
items.answer: Yes. You can activate new ones anytime from the Services Catalog or Member Zone.

items.question: How do I know which service fits me?
items.answer: BioMath Core guides you based on your snapshot of the day and most recent report. You can also browse every service description in the catalog below or in the Learning Center.

items.question: Are services static or adaptive?
items.answer: They are adaptive — content evolves with your data and progress.

items.question: What is the Member Zone?
items.answer: It is your personal interactive dashboard where all features live: reports, goals, snapshots, devices, second opinion, and chat.

items.question: What can I do on the dashboard?
items.answer: You see your current state, your trend, your goals for today, recent progress, and one gentle step to take.

items.question: What is the Daily Snapshot?
items.answer: A short explanation of "how your system is today" plus one soft recommendation.

items.question: How do goals and habits work?
items.answer: You choose small actions tied to your physiology. BioMath Core adapts difficulty automatically.

items.question: What are nudges?
items.answer: Short supportive prompts based on your state — not on timers.

items.question: Can I download my reports?
items.answer: Yes. PDF export is available in Pro.

items.question: Can I connect and disconnect devices?
items.answer: Yes, anytime.

items.question: What is the Signal Hub?
items.answer: Signal Hub summarizes your active data sources, signal strength, and recent changes so you can understand what your reports are built on.

items.question: Can I save and organize reports?
items.answer: Yes. You can mark reports as favorites and add personal notes for quick reference.

items.question: What can the assistant do?
items.answer: It explains your state, helps with reports, answers health-related questions in plain language, and converts insights into actions.

items.question: Is it text only or also voice?
items.answer: Supports both text and (in Pro) voice interaction.

items.question: How is this different from chatbots?
items.answer: It uses your personal context and state, not generic answers.

items.question: Can it guide me step-by-step?
items.answer: Yes. It can walk you through a report, plan, or routine like a human guide.

items.question: Does the assistant learn over time?
items.answer: Yes — it remembers style preferences (simple vs deep explanations).

items.question: What is multi-model mode?
items.answer: Multi-model mode runs more than one AI perspective at the same time to expand the breadth of analysis. It helps surface both physiological and behavioral insights.

items.question: What is "Second Opinion" in BioMath Core?
items.answer: It is a feature where you see two interpretations from two AI models — physiology view vs behavioral view.

items.question: Why two models?
items.answer: Because health has more than one dimension — body response and lifestyle influence.

items.question: When should I use Second Opinion?
items.answer: Whenever you want extra depth, reassurance, or a second explanation style.

items.question: Can I compare or merge them?
items.answer: Yes. You can compare side-by-side and merge into a final summary.

items.question: How does the aggregated report work?
items.answer: The system combines the strongest findings from each model into one unified report, with clear priorities and a single action plan.

items.question: Does second opinion replace a doctor?
items.answer: No. It complements human care — it does not replace medical professionals.

items.question: What is the Report Quality Score?
items.answer: A clarity and reliability indicator based on signal coverage, consistency, and data freshness. It helps you understand how strong the current report is.

items.question: What does Data Coverage mean?
items.answer: It shows how complete your inputs are across devices, questionnaires, notes, and reports. Higher coverage means deeper context.

items.question: What is a Knowledge Snapshot?
items.answer: A snapshot is BioMath Core's current understanding of your health state, built from your latest signals and history.

items.question: What is the Action Plan Builder?
items.answer: It turns insights into 7, 14, and 30-day steps with priorities and checkboxes, so progress is structured and gentle.

items.question: How does the AI report pipeline work?
items.answer: Signals are gathered from your devices, questionnaires, notes, and reports, then summarized into a knowledge snapshot. Multi-model analysis runs in parallel, and the strongest findings are merged into a unified report.

items.question: What is Memory Depth?
items.answer: Memory Depth reflects how much relevant history and context the system can access when generating your report. It increases as you add more signals.

items.question: What is the Knowledge Timeline?
items.answer: A timeline of key changes in your signals and reports so you can see how your context evolves over time.

items.question: Can I change report styles?
items.answer: Yes. You can view a quick summary, a balanced analysis, or a full deep-dive narrative depending on how much detail you want.

items.question: Which devices are supported?
items.answer: Apple Watch, Samsung, Fitbit, Amazon Halo, Oura, continuous glucose monitors, and other certified devices.

items.question: How do I connect a device?
items.answer: Through a guided step-by-step connection flow in the Member Zone.

items.question: Do you store raw health data?
items.answer: No. We interpret metrics — we do not need to store raw streams.

items.question: What if syncing stops?
items.answer: You'll see a reminder and can reconnect in one click.

items.question: Can I disable data sharing?
items.answer: Yes — instantly from settings.

items.question: How is my data protected?
items.answer: We use encryption, separation of personally identifiable data, and anonymization layers.

items.question: Do you sell or trade data?
items.answer: No. We never sell, license, or monetize personal health data.

items.question: Can I request deletion?
items.answer: Yes. Data deletion is available on demand.

items.question: Can I export my data?
items.answer: Yes, as PDF or raw JSON summary.

items.question: Where is data stored?
items.answer: In secure data centers compliant with modern privacy standards.

items.question: Is this a diagnostic tool?
items.answer: No. It is an insight and guidance service, not a diagnostic system.

items.question: What should I do in a medical emergency?
items.answer: Contact emergency services or a physician. BioMath Core is not for urgent care.

items.question: Can this replace my doctor?
items.answer: No — it complements professional care.

items.question: Can I share results with my doctor?
items.answer: Yes. You can export or show reports anytime.
